name: Playlist
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Sidebar playlist: add, sort, repeat and shuffle
description:
A playlist in the right sidebar: add files, folders and links, drag and drop, sort and search, repeat and shuffle, and add the similar files of the same folder when a file is opened; reads and writes M3U, M3U8 and PLS list files and restores the list after a restart.
Entry points: F6, "Sidebar" in the context menu and "Playlist: …" in the command palette.
→ Sidebar: Playlist tab (F6)
